spells.name: Blinding Assault
spells.description: Valor flies out and strikes the first enemy in his path, damaging and blinding all enemies near that point.
spells.tooltip:
As Quinn: Valor flies out and strikes the first enemy in his path. He then attacks all nearby enemies, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and Blinding them for {{ blindduration }} seconds.

As Valor: Attack all nearby enemies, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage and Blinding them for {{ blindduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Heightened Senses
spells.description:
Passive as Quinn: Gain attack and move speed for a few seconds when triggering Harrier.

Passive as Valor: Gain attack speed.

Active: Reveal a large area around Quinn and Valor.
spells.tooltip:
Passive as Quinn: Attacking a Vulnerable target gives Quinn {{ attackspeedbonus*100 }}% Attack Speed and {{ movespeedamount }} Movement Speed for {{ buffduration }} seconds.

Passive as Valor: Gain {{ valorattackspeed*100 }}% Attack Speed.

Active: Valor reveals a large area nearby for {{ visionduration }} seconds.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Vault
spells.description: Quinn or Valor dashes to an enemy, dealing damage, knocking back, and slowing their target. If cast as Quinn, she then vaults off of them, keeping her distance while Valor marks them with Harrier.
spells.tooltip:
As Quinn or Valor: Dash to an enemy, dealing {{ totaldamage }} physical damage, Knocking back and Slowing the target by {{ slowamount*100 }}%, decaying over {{ slowdecaytime }} seconds.

As Quinn: Additionally leap off her target and Valor will mark them as Vulnerable.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

spells.name: Tag Team
spells.description: Valor replaces Quinn on the battlefield as a mobile melee attacker, gaining movement speed and modifying her abilities. Cast again to perform Skystrike, damaging all nearby enemies.
spells.tooltip:
As Quinn: Valor replaces Quinn on the battlefield as a mobile melee attacker for {{ transformduration }} seconds. Valor is Ghosted and gains {{ oocmovespeed*100 }}% Move Speed, decaying to {{ combatmovespeed*100 }}% when in combat. Valor can then cast Skystrike.

As Valor: Skystrike: Quinn returns, dealing {{ totaldamage }} - {{ totaldamagemaximum }} physical damage to all enemies in a large area, based on how much health they are missing.{{ spellmodifierdescriptionappend }}

passive.name: Harrier
passive.description: Valor periodically marks enemies as Vulnerable, whom Quinn can attack to deal bonus damage.
